item.tib: gsas mkhar spyi spungs gab pa gsung chen las dbal chen e ka'i gsang mdos zlog pa las kyi thog mda'i 'khor lo
item.coloph: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs kyi nang nas/ gab pa gsung mchog mngon du phyung ba dbal chen e ka'i gsang mdos 'di yang / 'chi med yum sras gshen gsum nas gdung rabs rim bzhin du brgyud de bla chen dran pa nam mkha' la brgyud/ gshen po de yi ring la nam mkha' stong pa la rlung gi 'khor los dbang bsgyur te/ g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa 'char nub kyi skabs su bstan pa rin po che gter du gshegs te/ bon 'di rgyas 'bring bsdus pa gsum du phyes te/ cha cig dang ra khyung rdzong la sbas/ cha gcig thugs la gab/ cha gcig srid pa'i rgyal mo la gnyer du bcol/ phyis su lnga snyigs 'dul ba'i dbal bon khro bo lha rgod thog pa'i thugs las chad pa'i bu/ dbal 'bar stag slag can la srid pa'i rgyal mos snyan du brgyud nas bstan pa mi nub dar ba'i rgyu lags pas/ dbal gshen de nyid kyi ring la gdul bya'i smin grol rgya che ba dang*/ 'gro rnams las 'phro zhan pa dang / dus dang rkyen gyis 'phro lus shing pheb pa ma gyur kyang*/ phran bu rang la bon skal 'di yi gnyer gtad yang yang byung ba dang / phyis su gyim shod shel brag mjal skabs su/ yum chen srid rgyal khro mo'i tshul gyis gsang ba'i rag tas bsre ba mdzad nas bka' yis bkyon pa dang bcas te snyan du brgyud nas gdams pa'o/ de phyin du sa gsum 'gro ba'i mgon po sha ri dbu chen gyi snang brnyan grub dbang smon lam g.yung drung bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rjes 'jug rgyal tshab sprul pa'i sku mchog rin po che kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis dbang dar le rgan dmar po dang / rin chen man+Dal gyis sna drangs nas bka' nan spyi bor dbab pa dang*/ ma zad rang slob dge rgan sa trig sam sad dang mos ldan 'ga' yis bskul ba la brten nas/ shel skyes g.yung drung thogs med kyis gtan la phab pa'o//
